title: Bitcoin Price Prediction & Market Analysis: BTC AI Forecast and Technical Outlook
author: dvysrm
selftext:
I’ve been looking at Bitcoin today and thought this was an interesting setup.

BTC is currently around **$83,060**, down about **0.95% over the last 24 hours**. The 24-hour range is roughly **$82,228 to $83,936**, while the current 1-hour RSI is 42.

What caught my attention is that the AI model is currently **neutral with 52% confidence**, rather than giving a clear bullish or bearish signal. The expected 24-hour range is around **$82,397 to $83,723**.

The short-term trend is also slightly weaker, with the **1-hour EMA 9 below the EMA 21**, while RSI remains in the neutral zone.

This is basically why I’ve been building CallPutCrypto. Instead of only looking at the Bitcoin price, I wanted a page that combines the live market data, technical indicators, AI signal, expected range, support/resistance and news context in one place.

The Bitcoin analysis page updates the price every 15 seconds and recalculates the signal every minute.

I’m still actively developing the platform and improving the crypto forecasting and market analysis models.
